description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single hybrid attacks (0.60 or 225.0 each), grants [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Tri-Element Mode III (Fire, Lightning, Water)] and [Eblan Unity] to the user

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Tri-Element Mode III (Fire, Lightning, Water)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Water 2 with Stacking] after using a Fire/Lightning/Water ability

description.name: Eblan Unity
description.text: Grants [Attach X] after using three of Eblan Surge or Eblan Struggle if the character has any [Attach X]
